name: Trigenys Aegis
tagline: A suspicious event is a signal; a correlated sequence is an incident that teams can actually investigate.
problem: Independent SaaS applications produce disconnected login, permission and payment events. Without correlation, an attacker can escalate privileges and alter sensitive settings while each local log looks innocuous.
scenario: Repeated administrative login failures are followed by a new successful session and a beneficiary change. The security layer must correlate these authenticated events, explain the supporting evidence and request human confirmation before any consequential action.
differentiation: Multi-tenant security correlation must be deterministic, evidence-backed and privacy-aware; optional generative summaries are advisory and must never grant authorization for destructive incident responses.
architecture: Authenticated tenant-scoped events -> schema validation -> redacted off-chain evidence storage -> deterministic correlation -> explained incident -> human-controlled notification/response -> optional batch integrity anchor.
limitations: The current repository is only an API scaffold. No operational security collection, detection analytics, incident response, external assurance or production blockchain integration has been shipped.

capabilities.name: Authenticated event ingestion
capabilities.description: Provide tenant-isolated producer authentication, strict event contracts, safe normalization and replay protection.

capabilities.name: Deterministic detection
capabilities.description: Correlate documented multi-event patterns while retaining source evidence and policy versions.

capabilities.name: Incident integrity verification
capabilities.description: Use independently verifiable fingerprints of protected evidence without exposing raw logs on public chains.

roadmap.name: Security foundation
roadmap.exitCriteria: Tenant-aware source authentication and the agreed cross-tenant threat suite pass in CI.

roadmap.name: Detection MVP
roadmap.exitCriteria: Five tested detection workflows produce source-linked incidents with replay-safe inputs.

roadmap.name: Evidence assurance
roadmap.exitCriteria: Independent verifier detects intentional tampering and retention policies are documented.
